brief:
A Palestinian organization monitoring Jerusalem affairs cautioned against allowing settlers to regularly storm Al-Aqsa Mosque on Saturdays, Shehab Wire reported. Nasser Al-Hadmi, head of the Jerusalem-based unit against Judaization, said the incursions constitute implementation of a Zionist plan to impose complete sovereignty over the mosque.

The organization views the repeated Saturday raids as part of a broader scheme to normalize settler access to the holy site and establish Israeli control over it.
dek: A Palestinian organization monitoring Jerusalem affairs cautioned against allowing settlers to regularly storm Al-Aqsa Mosque on Saturdays, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Palestinian group warns of Saturday temple raids becoming routine
